description_en: Lists images in a media set. The results are sorted in ascending order by the time when the images were added to the media set
description_zh: 获取媒体集中的图片列表，返回结果以图片加入媒体集的时间升序排序
kebab_example: aliyun imm list-images --project immimagetest --set-id set001 --create-time-start 2020-11-23T07:49:01.975Z --marker image --limit 10 --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListImages

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the media set
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range during which the images were created. Only images that were added to the media set after this time are returned
parameters.help_zh: 图片创建时间的起始点，返回的图片均在此时间后加入媒体集
parameters.name: create_time_start

parameters.help_en: Returns the list of image information in lexicographic order starting from the Marker value. If this parameter is not specified, images are returned from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 从Marker开始按字典序返回图片信息列表。如果不设置此参数，则从头开始返回图片
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of images to return. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 返回图片的最大数量，默认值为20，取值范围为1~100
parameters.name: limit

Address.description_en:
The image geolocation detection result.

This parameter has a value only when the image contains geolocation information
Address.description_zh:
图片地理位置检测结果。

只有图片中包含地理位置信息时，检测结果才有值

AddressLine.description_en: The full address of the image geolocation
AddressLine.description_zh: 图片地理位置的完整地址
AddressLine.example: 浙江省杭州市西湖区转塘街道石龙山西路

City.description_en: The city (or equivalent level) of the image geolocation
City.description_zh: 图片地理位置所在城市（或同级）

Country.description_en: The country or region of the image geolocation
Country.description_zh: 图片地理位置所在国家或地区

District.description_en: The district (or equivalent level) of the image geolocation
District.description_zh: 图片地理位置所在区（或同级）

Province.description_en: The province (or equivalent level) of the image geolocation
Province.description_zh: 图片地理位置所在省（或同级）

Township.description_en: The street (or equivalent level) of the image geolocation
Township.description_zh: 图片地理位置所在街道（或同级）

AddressFailReason.description_en:
The failure reason of image geolocation detection.

This parameter has a value only when image geolocation detection fails
AddressFailReason.description_zh:
图片地理位置检测的失败原因。

只有当图片地理位置检测失败时，此参数才有值

AddressModifyTime.description_en: The time when the image geolocation detection result was last updated
AddressModifyTime.description_zh: 图片地理位置检测的更新时间

AddressStatus.description_en:
The status of image geolocation detection. Valid values:

NotProcessed: not processed.
Processing: being processed.
Success: succeeded.
Failed: failed.

You can determine whether to read results, wait, or retry based on this status
AddressStatus.description_zh:
图片地理位置检测的状态，包括如下选项：

NotProcessed：未处理
Processing：处理中
Success：成功
Failed：失败

您可以根据该状态决定读取结果、等待或重试

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the image was added to the media set
CreateTime.description_zh: 图片加入媒体集的时间

CroppingSuggestion.description_en: The cropping suggestions for the image

Height.description_en: The height of the cropping bounding box. Unit: px

Left.description_en: The X coordinate of the top-left vertex, which is the distance from the left edge. Unit: px
Left.description_zh: 顶点X坐标，距离左端距离。单位为px

Top.description_en: The Y coordinate of the top-left vertex, which is the distance from the top edge. Unit: px
Top.description_zh: 顶点Y坐标，距离顶端距离。单位为px

Width.description_en: The width of the cropping bounding box. Unit: px

Score.description_en: The aesthetic score of the cropping scheme. A higher score indicates a better result. Valid values: 0 to 1
Score.description_zh: 该裁剪方案的美学分数，分数越高表示该方案效果越好，取值范围为0～1

CroppingSuggestionFailReason.description_en:

裁剪建议提供失败的原因。

只有当图片裁剪建议提供失败时，此参数才有值

Exif.description_zh: 图片原始EXIF信息，以JSON Object序列化后的格式存储

ExternalId.description_en: The external ID, which is used to associate with the ID in your application layer, if any

Attractive.description_en: The face attractiveness score. A higher score indicates stronger attractiveness. Valid values: 0 to 1
Attractive.description_zh: 人脸吸引力，分数越高吸引力越强，取值范围为0~1

EmotionDetails.description_en: The confidence scores of the seven emotions
EmotionDetails.description_zh: 七种心情对应的置信度

ANGRY.description_en: The confidence score of the ANGRY emotion

CALM.description_en: The confidence score of the CALM emotion

DISGUSTED.description_en: The confidence score of the DISGUSTED emotion

HAPPY.description_en: The confidence score of the HAPPY emotion

SAD.description_en: The confidence score of the SAD emotion

SCARED.description_en: The confidence score of the SCARED emotion

SURPRISED.description_en: The confidence score of the SURPRISED emotion

Beard.description_en: Whether the person has a beard

BeardConfidence.description_en: The confidence score of whether the person has a beard

Height.description_en: The height of the face bounding box. Unit: px

Top.description_en: The Y coordinate of the top-left vertex, which is the distance from the top edge. Unit: px

Width.description_en: The width of the face bounding box. Unit: px

GlassesConfidence.description_en: The confidence score of whether the person wears glasses

Pitch.description_en: The pitch angle of the face. Valid values: `-180 to +180` degrees. Recommended reliable range: `-30 to +30` degrees
Pitch.description_zh: 人脸的俯仰角，取值范围为`-180～+180`度，可信的范围建议为`-30～+30`度

Roll.description_en: The roll angle of the face. Valid values: `-180 to +180` degrees. Recommended reliable range: `-45 to +45` degrees
Roll.description_zh: 面内偏转角，取值范围为`-180～+180`度，可信的建议范围为`-45～+45`度

Yaw.description_en: The yaw angle of the face. Valid values: `-180 to +180` degrees. Recommended reliable range: `-80 to +80` degrees
Yaw.description_zh: 人脸的左右偏转角，取值范围为`-180～+180`度，可信的范围建议为`-80～+80`度

Mask.description_en: Whether the person wears a mask

MaskConfidence.description_en: The confidence score of whether the person wears a mask

Gender.description_en: The gender. Valid values: MALE and FEMALE

GroupId.description_en: The face group ID. If the face is not grouped, the value of this parameter is group-not-grouped
GroupId.description_zh: 人脸分组ID。如果人脸未分组，则此参数返回值为group-not-grouped

ImageTime.description_en:
The shooting date of the image, which is obtained from the EXIF information.

If the EXIF information of the image does not contain this information, this parameter is not included in the response
ImageTime.description_zh:
图片的拍摄日期，该日期从EXIF信息中获取。

如果图片EXIF信息无此信息，则返回结果中无此参数

ImageUri.description_en: The OSS URI of the image

Location.description_en:
The geolocation of the image, which is obtained from the EXIF information. The format is `lat,long`, consisting of floating-point numbers separated by a comma (,).

If the EXIF information of the image does not contain this information, this parameter is not included in the response
Location.description_zh:
图片地理位置，从EXIF信息中获取，格式为`lat,long`，以英文逗号（,）分隔的浮点数。

如果图片EXIF信息无此信息，则返回结果中无此参数

ModifyTime.description_en:
The modification time of the image.

After an image is added, if it has not been modified, the modification time is the same as the creation time
ModifyTime.description_zh:
图片的修改时间。

添加图片后，如果未修改过图片，则图片的修改时间和图片的创建时间相同

Width.description_en: The width of the text bounding box. Unit: px
Width.description_zh: 文字位置框宽度。单位为px

This parameter takes effect only when SourceType is set to video.

The position of the image frame on the timeline of the source video. The format is `00000000.010`, that is, %8.3f
SourcePosition.description_zh:
只有当SourceType为video时，此参数才生效。

视频中该图片帧处于源视频的时间轴位置。格式为`00000000.010`，即%8.3f

CentricScore.description_en: The centric score of the tag. This parameter indicates the prominence of the tag content in the image. A higher score indicates that the tag is more likely the main subject of the image. Valid values: 0 to 1
CentricScore.description_zh: 标签主体分数。用于提示该标签内容在图片中的主要程度，越高则说明该标签越可能为图片主体。取值范围为0~1

TagLevel.description_en: The tag level. Valid values: 1 to 4

TagsFailReason.description_en:
The failure reason of tag recognition. The format is `[HTTPStatusCode ErrorCode] ErrorMessage`, for example, `[400 InvalidResource] Specified resource is too large. Please check.`

This parameter has a value only when tag recognition fails
TagsFailReason.description_zh:
标签识别的失败原因。格式为`[HTTPStatusCode ErrorCode] ErrorMessage`，例如`[400 InvalidResource] Specified resource is too large. Please check.`

只有当标签识别失败时，此参数才有值

TagsModifyTime.description_en: The time when the tag recognition result was last updated. This value is updated when TagsStatus changes
TagsModifyTime.description_zh: 标签识别的更新时间。当TagsStatus更改时更新

NextMarker.description_en:
Use this value as the Marker in the next request to return the remaining results.

This parameter has a value only when not all images are returned
NextMarker.description_zh:
下一次列出图片信息时以此值为Marker，将未返回的结果返回。

当图片未全部返回时，此参数才有值
